projects.title: Solar Power Forecasting
highlights: Conducted feature engineering to enhance model robustness and reduce prediction error.
Investigated and evaluated Machine Learning and Deep Learning architectures to forecast short-term and multi-horizon solar power output.

projects.title: Chemical Identification via Electrical Sensor Analysis
highlights: Performed Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and investigated signal patterns from electrical sensors to classify chemical compositions.
Conducted a systematic performance analysis and authored a comprehensive technical report detailing methodology and experimental results.

projects.title: Interference Identification and Localization (Project iSpectra)
highlights: Contributed to the development of Deep Learning modules for radio frequency interference classification and source localization in 4G/5G networks at Viettel Software.
Developed and optimized a signal source localization module, achieving high precision in identifying interference coordinates within complex network topologies.

experience.organization: School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering - Hanoi University of Science and Technology

Collaborated with Backend and Business Analyst teams to deploy the tasked engine as a scalable RESTful API.
Performed literature reviews and joined technical seminars to refine model architectures.
